claims.object_text: association with key differential immune cell infiltration (CD56bright natural killer cell, Immature B cell and Type 1 T helper cell) in intracranial aneurysm
claims.quote: In this study, 7 key DEmRNAs (NRXN1, GRIA2, SLC1A2, SLC17A7, IL6, VEGFA and SYP) associated with key differential immune cell infiltration (CD56bright natural killer cell, Immature B cell and Type 1 T helper cell) were identified.
